run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for load balancing a DataLoader from an LMDB dataset
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run the argparse parser to get command line arguments for the LMDB sizes script
run_get_data: run the get_data function to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a dataset index
run_make_lmdb_sizes_function: run the make_lmdb_sizes function to compute and save atom and neighbor counts to metadata.npz
review_make_lmdb_sizes: review the make_lmdb_sizes script that generates metadata.npz files for fairchem DataLoader load balancing
